method: For each mouse, empirical fraction of all D0 events <= each magnitude; group curve is arithmetic mean of mouse CDFs. Right-continuous unsmoothed steps. Each mouse equal, cages not equally weighted.
interpretation: Descriptive baseline comparison; overlap is not evidence of equivalence. No statistical tests.
selection: All 900 D0 events including stop overlaps and outside-tape events; no clipping, no zero or nonfinite magnitudes
